quote: When stopping is required at a railroad crossing the driver shall keep as far to the right of the highway as possible and shall not form two lanes of traffic unless the highway is marked for four or more lanes of traffic.

activation.condition: A stop is required at a railroad crossing.

obligation.description: Keep as far right as possible; do not form two traffic lanes unless the highway has at least four marked lanes.

exceptions.trigger: highway marked for four or more lanes
exceptions.effect: qualifies only the two-lanes prohibition; far-right duty remains
exceptions.replacement_obligation: keep as far right as possible
exceptions.source_clause: unless the highway is marked for four or more lanes of traffic

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: stopping is required at a railroad crossing
judgment_calls_needed.note: independent original authority, gate and crossing source needed

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: as far to the right of the highway as possible
judgment_calls_needed.note: review available right-side space and surrounding traffic
